basic_details.job_title: NIA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 111 DEO, ASI, Head Constable Posts
basic_details.post_name: Assistant Sub-Inspector, Head Constable & Data Entry Operator
basic_details.short_information: National Investigation Agency (NIA) has announced 111 vacancies for Assistant Sub-Inspector, Head Constable, and Data Entry Operator posts on a deputation basis under its 2026 recruitment. The notified pay level is Pay Level-5 (Rs. 29,200-92,300) for Assistant Sub-Inspector and Data Entry Operator, and Pay Level-4 (Rs. 25,500-81,700) for Head Constable. Eligible candidates can apply through the offline mode by sending the completed application by post to DIG(Adm), NIA HQ, Opposite CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi within 60 days from publication (about 20 December 2026). The selection process

age_limit.details: Assistant Sub-Inspector: Maximum age 56 years. Head Constable: Maximum age 56 years. Data Entry Operator: Maximum age 56 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduation for ASI, 12th pass for Head Constable, 'O' or 'A' level certificate in IT for Data Entry Operator with required experience.
qualification.details: Assistant Sub-Inspector: Graduation from a recognized university. Experience of at least 02 years in investigation of criminal cases, intelligence work or operations or information technology management. Head Constable: 12th class pass or equivalent from any recognized Board of University. Experience in intelligence work. Data Entry Operator: 'O' or 'A' level certificate for Information Technology from an Institute recognised by the Government. Holding analogous posts on regular basis in parent cadre or department.

selection_process: Deputation screening based on bio-data and APAR dossier
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.nia.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-12-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Investigation Agency (NIA) for filling up various defense and security administration posts across India on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under NIA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 111 vacancies announced for Assistant Sub-Inspector, Head Constable, and Data Entry Operator positions in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts include Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI), Head Constable, and Data Entry Operator (DEO) under the National Investigation Agency.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NIA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted through offline mode by sending the filled proforma along with required documents through post to the designated NIA headquarters address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 20 December 2026, which is approximately 60 days from the date of publication of the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts—Assistant Sub-Inspector, Head Constable, and Data Entry Operator—is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required for Head Constable?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Head Constable post must have passed the 12th class or equivalent from any recognized Board or University along with experience in intelligence work.

faq.question: Q8. What qualifications are needed for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Data Entry Operator position must hold analogous posts on a regular basis and possess an 'O' or 'A' level certificate in Information Technology.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for Assistant Sub-Inspector?
faq.answer: The Assistant Sub-Inspector post falls under Pay Level-5, offering a salary range of Rs. 29,200 to Rs. 92,300 in the government pay matrix.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with necessary documents should be sent to the DIG(Adm), NIA HQ, Opposite CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.
